sentences.text:
Author: T. Vinod Kumar
Bench: T. Vinod Kumar
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice T. Vinod Kumar
 Contempt Case No.1088 of 2024
Order:
This Contempt Case is filed alleging willful disobedience to the order dt.21.09.2023 passed by this Court in W.P.No.11956 of 2019.

2. Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition and learned Government Pleader for Irrigation and CAD submit that to comply with the order of this Court dt.21.09.2023 in W.P.No.11956 of 2019, the authorities have now initiated action by issuing preliminary notification under Section 11 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short, 'the Act'), for acquiring the lands in Sy.No.53 situated at Bogulampally Village, Raikode Mandal; and that the aforesaid preliminary notification under Section 11 of the Act has been published in the State Gazette on 15.10.2024 and also in the Vernacular Newspaper 'Andhra Jyothi' on 28.10.2024.
3.

Learned Government Pleaders thus submit that since the authorities have initiated proceedings for acquiring the lands in Sy.No.53, the authorities would take further action to complete the aforesaid proceeding in terms of the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as amended by Act 21 of 2017.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. By stating as above, learned Government Pleaders seek three months time for completing the entire exercise of acquisition of the land in Sy.No.53 as per preliminary notification published in vernacular newspaper on 28.10.2024.

5. Having regard to the submissions made as above, and since, the respondents have now indicated to this Court that the proceedings having been initiated, the same would be completed within the timelines prescribed under the Act, thereby purging themselves from the contempt, this Court is of the view that the respondents-authorities are to be directed to purge themselves of the contempt, by complying with the order within three (03) months time from today as sought for, by completing all the further process in relation to acquisition.

It is made clear that in the event of the respondents-authorities fail to complete the entire exercise as per the statement made to this Court,
today, the contempt case would stand revived.
6. Accordingly, the Contempt Case is closed.
7. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this writ petition shall stand closed.
